modules.name: Leisure Hours
missions: During battle, have your own Catherine deploy a total of 15 Support Devices
Clear Main Theme 11-7 with a 3-star rating under Standard Environment; You must deploy your own Catherine, and have her use Tempered by War at least 2 times

talents.name: Directional Support Signal
talents.description: Carries 3 Support Devices (max 2 deployed at once) that grant an Operator a <$ba.barrier>Barrier</> equal to 25% of Catherine's Max HP (if target has not received an attack within 5s, <$ba.barrier>Barrier</> replenishes by 6% of Catherine's Max HP every second, cannot go over the starting limit); effects from Devices do not stack
